issue_request: FHIR-17363 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that CodeSystem pages display the current business version, ValueSet pages display the business version for the definition shown, and displayed expansions clarify which code system version was used.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 13944. Git commit 6259891d42d22190d1908d9ba8f5058b0c6582dd, dated 2018-07-17 and titled GF#17363 - Add business version to display for code systems and value sets, added Version rows/tokens to code system/value set templates plus renderer and PageProcessor support. Later refactors moved the active templates from source/template-* to tools/templates and tools/tx while retaining the version display behavior.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml keeps Code Systems and Value Sets under the active Terminology section and declares generated pages for code systems and value sets. Current tools/templates and tools/tx templates render <%csver%> or <%vsver%> and retain the ValueSet expansion block. build.fhir.org AdministrativeGender examples show _Version_: 6.0.0-ballot4 on both CodeSystem and ValueSet pages, and the ValueSet expansion states it was generated based on codesystem AdministrativeGender v6.0.0-ballot4. Related FHIR-13820 concerns $expand input parameters and intentionally did not add a code-system-version input parameter, so it does not imply additional display work for this issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope templates and rendered CI output already satisfy the display and expansion-provenance requirements from FHIR-17363.
